mapper.select: SELECT FROM coop_invite_request_receipt WHERE principal_member_id=#{principalMemberId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT FROM coop_invite_request_receipt WHERE principal_member_id=#{principalMemberId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, invite_type AS inviteType, to_type AS toType, to_id AS toId, node_id AS nodeId, status FROM coop_invite WHERE topic_id=#{topicId} AND del_flag=0 AND (status=1 OR (status=0 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > #{now}) AND (create_time IS NULL OR create_time > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 48 HOUR)))) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coop_invite_request_receipt (principal_member_id, request_id, fingerprint_version, fingerprint, from_type, from_id, from_owner_member_id, to_owner_member_id, scope, invite_type, topic_id, to_type, to_id) VALUES (#{principalMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{fingerprintVersion}, #{fingerprint}, #{fromType}, #{fromId}, #{fromOwnerMemberId}, #{toOwnerMemberId}, #{scope}, #{inviteType}, #{topicId}, #{toType}, #{toId})
mapper.update: UPDATE coop_invite_request_receipt SET invite_id=#{inviteId} WHERE id=#{id} AND invite_id IS NULL
